title: Minimal intersection radius for $n$ growing, non-homogeneous ellipsoids in $\mathbb{R}^d$
summary: In this paper, we compute the Minimal Intersection Radius (MIR) of growing, non-homogeneous ellipsoids in arbitrary ambient dimension. We provide a geometric method to find the MIR using techniques from convex optimization, a secondary method using second-order cone programs, and show that the MIR can be phrased as an LP-type problem, where the computation from convex optimization acts as a certificate.
